messages.content: 关于论文《A computational linguistic study of personal recovery in bipolar disorder》，How are the individuals with bipolar disorder identified?

claims.text: Twitter and Reddit users with a BD diagnosis will be identified automatically via self-reported diagnosis statements, such as “I was diagnosed with BD-I last week”.
To perform this automatic identification, the study will extend on the diagnosis patterns and terms for BD provided by prior work (BIBREF47).
Relevant blogs authored by affected individuals will be manually identified, and their authors will be contacted to obtain informed consent for using their texts.

Data relevant for BD in general and for personal recovery in BD will be collected from three sources: Twitter, Reddit (focusing on mental health-related content, unlike previous work), and blogs authored by affected individuals.

claims.text: 研究计划从三个来源收集与双相障碍（BD）及个人康复相关的数据：Twitter、Reddit（侧重于心理健康相关内容，不同于先前工作）以及由受影响个体撰写的博客。
Twitter 和 Reddit 上具有 BD 诊断的用户将通过自我报告的诊断陈述被自动识别，例如“I was diagnosed with BD-I last week”。
为实现上述自动识别，研究将扩展 BIBREF47 所提供的 BD 诊断模式和术语。
相关博客将被人工识别，并联系其作者以获得使用其文本的知情同意。
对于 Twitter 和 Reddit 用户，假定其对这些平台上的公开推文和帖子给予默示同意。
此前已有针对包括 BD 在内的多种状况的数据集，使用 Twitter 和 Reddit 的公开社交媒体数据；但 Twitter 数据集无法供进一步研究，且两个 Reddit 数据集中的心理健康相关内容被有意移除。
该项目的总体目标是考察社交媒体帖子所传达的信息能在多大程度上补充临床心理学中更传统的研究方法，以了解具有 BD 诊断的个体的康复体验。

messages.content: 与《A Readable Read: Automatic Assessment of Language Learning Materials based on Linguistic Complexity》对比，分别说明两篇论文如何回答“How are the individuals with bipolar disorder identified?”与“what linguistics features did they apply?”，并说明是否具有可比性。
